notes: SHIP v1.14.356 - ASSET-ONLY STAGING SHIP for the pending BUILD banner rows. Adds THREE phone-shell (1170x403) banner rasters to icons/ - scan, master, ops - and registers all three in sw.js PRECACHE_URLS. NO MARKUP CHANGE: dct-ios.html carries the version-stamp bump ONLY (diff is exactly one line); the 12-tile BUILD grid, the OPS registry, the TOOLS/REF grid and the platform picker are all untouched, and nothing in the app references these files yet. Batch position: 2 of 6 (batch opened at .355). OWNER RULING 2026-07-30 - SHIP THE CLEAN THREE: this ship was first prepared with FIVE assets. The phantom-rd-reviewer gate returned CHANGES-REQUESTED on two of them and John ruled to ship the three that passed and hold the two that did not. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: (a) phantom-banner-handoff-1170.webp - carries legible baked UI text asserting a fabricated completed workflow (HANDOFF / RACK BUILD / CABLE REPORT / POWER CHECK / INTAKE SYNC / Complete / READY FOR HANDOFF), plus a fabricated wireframe rack elevation and a SECOND baked PHANTOM wordmark and ghost-mark on the glove cuff. Confirmed legible at native 1:1 crop, which IS the on-device retina resolution for a 390pt row - not a magnification artifact. Violates the icon law (no large legible title words on icon art; the only owner exception of record is the MASTER FILE plaque) and the no-fabricated-telemetry rule. (b) phantom-banner-deploy-1170.webp - GB300 NVL72 baked legibly on rack faceplates twice in full. The app ships site-agnostic per Design Law 6, so an incorrect platform label would render as the DEPLOY entry-point art at every site; AUS-01 runs H100/H200 with no Blackwell on the floor. GATE CHARTER POINT THAT DECIDED IT: both assets are recorded 'Accepted' only in web-Claude authored docs and were never ruled by John in chat - doc-authored 'Accepted' is not owner consent. Both files remain staged outside the repo pending a re-cut (remove or blur the tablet checklist text, the glove wordmark, and the GB300 faceplates) or an explicit owner ruling. SCOPE AND WHY IT IS SPLIT: the full BUILD banner-row port (12-tile grid at ~13201-13215 to five full-width 2.90:1 rows plus an in-place 10-cell OPS wall) is BLOCKED on nine owner rulings and is deliberately NOT in this ship - chiefly that NO ASSET-SHELL MECHANISM EXISTS (see below), that NEITHER reference mock wires a single row handler (porting either literally would ship five dead taps into a hidden-success path), and that the two mocks disagree on class contract and scrim value. Landing the assets first is reversible in one commit and keeps the markup ship small. TRADEOFF ACCEPTED: until the markup lands, these three files are precached but referenced by nothing - about 168KB of cold-install weight for zero user-visible benefit, the same waste the handoff itself criticises in the 16 existing dead PRECACHE_URLS entries. If the markup ship does not follow, revert this commit rather than leave them. ASSET PROVENANCE: ops was cut from its LOSSLESS PNG master (OPS-master-290.png 2135x736) so it is generation-1. scan and master were cut from lossy WebP masters base64-extracted from the web-Claude mock phantom-BUILD-phone.html, so they are generation-2 (measured upper-bound penalty 1.75 dB PSNR versus a gen-1 path); no lossless master exists on disk for either. PIPELINE: sharp 0.35.3 / libwebp 1.6.0, fit cover, position center, kernel lanczos3, withoutEnlargement true, webp quality 82 alphaQuality 95 effort 6 (= cwebp -q 82 -alpha_q 95 -m 6; alphaQuality is a measured no-op here - every source is 3-channel with no ALPH chunk, verified by re-encoding at 0/95/100 and getting bit-identical output). All three outputs verified at exactly 1170x403, aspect 2.90323, inside the 2.89-2.91 accept band. LETTERBOX FIX (the find that changed an asset): the MASTER master is padded - its bottom 22 rows are dead black, so its real content aspect is 2.99174, OUTSIDE the accept band and worse than the 2.9945 that made OPS a blocker. Every doc and the first cut accepted the padded 2.9037 figure, which baked a black band across the bottom of the banner. The cutter used here de-letterboxes BEFORE fitting: MASTER is cut from content 2172x726, trimming 35.7px of width, and the output has zero residual dead edges (verified by re-scanning the written file). SCAN likewise had 5 dead left columns removed. The cutter also hard-refuses any enlargement - it declined handoff-2100 (1.1849x) and scan-2100 (1.0029x) rather than upscale hero art. GATES: phantom-ship-gate PASS (three-stamp lockstep, inline-JS vm.Script x3 blocks=4 failures=0, sw.js node --check, valid JSON, CSS braces net 0, surgical diff, line endings clean, every PRECACHE_URLS entry resolves on disk); phantom-rd-reviewer re-run on the reduced three-asset diff. CORRECTION OF RECORD: an earlier draft of these notes claimed all 59 pre-existing icons/ files are 1:1 square and that -1170 would be the first non-square. That was FALSE - measured, 45 are square and 14 are NOT, including phantom-ui-assistant-256.webp at 184x256 (ar 0.719, the art-sizing-trap example from the rules) and five phantom-optic-* files as far off as 1.5:1. The -256 suffix already means long-edge/bounding-box, not square-edge. The residual concern is only that this directory has shipped the art-sizing bug once before, so a clearer suffix (-1170w or -banner) would help before any markup wires a single dimension attribute to these. Not blocking. OPEN RULINGS that block the markup ship: (1) NO ASSET-SHELL MECHANISM - measured 0 picture, 0 srcset, 0 image-set, 0 container queries, 0 width-based matchMedia, 0 shell body class in dct-ios.html; shells split by CSS media query only (640/768/980/1024/1400). The handoff's instruction to match whatever mechanism the app already uses is unsatisfiable; adding one is an owner ruling. The prior attempt is dead at repo root - plate.webp and plate-wide.webp, 851KB, zero references, orphaned .pe-platepic CSS. Hence phone-only here and no -2100 files. (2) ROW HANDLERS - neither mock wires any; the only onclick in the phone mock is the OPS toggle. (3) WHICH MOCK IS AUTHORITATIVE - build-mock-all5.html uses .rows/.row/.art/--acc and carries the locked rgba(2,4,7,.72) scrim but only 880x303 preview art; phantom-BUILD-phone.html carries the real full-size art but uses .bnr/.bscrim/--rfac and a different rgba(4,6,10,...) scrim. (4) CHANNEL COLOURS - the OPS wall introduces #30d158 green plus off-map #ff8a00 and #2892ff. (5) OPS SLOT SHAPE - the mock renders OPS as .opshead with a FIXED height 96px and no aspect-ratio, a 3.771:1 box, so a 2.90 OPS asset is hard cover-cropped there; B4 was re-cut against the wrong target. (6) SCAN and MASTER both visibly break the directive left-45-percent dead-zone lighting rule - SCAN has a full-width lateral beam plus floor specular and a ceiling run; MASTER's brightest column in the whole frame is at 9.2 percent across. Both are recorded Accepted. Shipping the rasters does not rule on their composition. (7) LABEL ZONE - the directive says the left 45 percent is where the label sits; the mock's .btxt runs to 74 percent. (8) SAMPLE_STATE in the mock hardcodes readouts that must bind to Master before shipping. (9) SILENT-FAILURE HAZARD for the markup ship - .bnr has no background fallback and alt is empty, so a banner whose asset fails to load renders as a clean empty card that looks deliberate; sw.js install is Promise.allSettled with console.warn only and the fetch handler self-caches online, so a missing precache entry is invisible online AND the cold offline install breaks looking fine. When the markup lands, its asset references and their PRECACHE_URLS entries must land in the SAME commit and be verified by an actual airplane-mode cold load, not an eyeball check. DESK SET (not shipped, staged outside the repo): ops-2100, master-2100 and deploy-2100 exist and are clean; scan cannot reach 2100 without a 1.0029x upscale (honest alternative cut at 2094x724, scale exactly 1.0000); handoff-2100 is IMPOSSIBLE from its master - 1774x611 needs 1.1849x enlargement and 611 is below the directive's 724px minimum master height, so HANDOFF owes a re-render for the desk shell regardless of the baked-text ruling. DEVICE-VERIFY for this ship is minimal (clear SW first): the app must look and behave EXACTLY as .355 everywhere - no visual change is expected anywhere, because no markup changed. Confirm the version stamp reads v1.14.356, then airplane-mode + hard reload and confirm the app still boots fully offline (this exercises the enlarged precache). ROLLBACK: revert this commit; it removes the three files and the three precache entries together.
